overview: The atlas begins the robust echinoderm body-fossil record with articulated faunas by about 510 Ma, where several distinct body plans are already present. Older isolated skeletal pieces and a contested Fortunian fossil remain separate evidence.

ecology.diet: Diverse across the phylum; no ancestral diet inferred
ecology.locomotion: Sessile to mobile across sampled body plans
ecology.bodySize: Microscopic ossicles to large articulated bodies

traits: Multiple differentiated pentaradial and non-pentaradial body plans
evidenceSummary: Articulated faunas, isolated stereom ossicles and Yanjiahella answer different questions. None alone fixes the phylum’s origin, a global centre of origin or one ancestral ecology.

title.en: Do not merge three different fossil signals
title.zh: 三种不同化石信号不能合并

text.en: Isolated stereom ossicles, tiny pieces of diagnostic echinoderm skeletal microstructure, occur earlier than articulated bodies. By about 510 Ma, articulated faunas include at least four differentiated body plans. The Fortunian fossil Yanjiahella has been proposed as a stem echinoderm, but it lacks unambiguous echinoderm synapomorphies and stereom, so its placement remains contested.
text.zh: 更早的材料是孤立 stereom 骨片，即可诊断的棘皮动物骨骼微观结构的小碎片；它们并不是相连的完整身体。到约 510 Ma，已经有至少四种分化明显的相连体制。寒武纪幸运期的 Yanjiahella 曾被提议为棘皮动物干群成员，但它没有明确的棘皮动物共有衍征或 stereom，因此位置仍有争议。

title.en: An early record is not an origin date
title.zh: 早期记录不等于起源日期

text.en: The robust endpoint used here is the articulated fauna, not the older microscopic skeletal pieces or the contested Yanjiahella assignment. Highlighted articulated records come from Gondwanan regions, but they do not locate a global origin or map the full Cambrian distribution. Echinoderms also span different body plans and ways of life, so one diet or mode of movement is not assigned to the phylum’s ancestor.
text.zh: 本页采用的可靠界限是相连的化石群，而不是更早的微小骨骼碎片或有争议的 Yanjiahella 归属。重点介绍的相连化石来自冈瓦纳地区，但它们不能定位全球起源中心，也不能绘出完整寒武纪分布。棘皮动物具有多种体制与生活方式，因此不为该门的祖先指定单一食性或运动方式。

overview: Sea urchins and sand dollars belong to Echinoidea, but its deep history is not read from one clock. Darriwilian plates assigned to the total group show echinoid relatives in the Ordovician; a phylogenomic analysis instead estimates the crown group’s origin near the Carboniferous–Permian boundary. The fossil records an occurrence, while the model estimates a divergence under its assumptions.
overviewZh: 海胆和沙钱都属于 Echinoidea，但它的深时历史不能由同一种“时钟”读出。达瑞威尔期骨板表明海胆总群的近缘支系已见于奥陶纪；一项系统基因组分析则把冠群起源估在更晚的石炭纪—二叠纪交界附近。前者是化石出现，后者是在模型假设下估计的分化时间。

ecology.diet: Living echinoids include omnivores and detritivores. Those present-day feeding modes do not yet resolve the diet of the class ancestor.
ecology.habitat: The class occupies marine seafloors from shallow settings to deep water; the cited global record does not reduce that span to one habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Some species live on the sediment surface and others within it. Neither epifaunal nor infaunal life describes the entire class.
ecology.bodySize: The cited global occurrence analysis does not estimate a class-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: Echinoidea spans several feeding and living modes, so the evidence supports no single guild assignment for the class.
ecology.habitatZh: 本纲生活于从浅水到深水的海底；所引全球记录并未将这一范围归结为单一生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有些物种生活在沉积物表面，有些则生活在沉积物内部。表栖或内栖都不能描述整个海胆纲。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引全球分布记录分析没有估算海胆纲整体的体型范围。

traits: The test is assembled from calcitic plates; these durable pieces are among the evidence used to trace the group’s fossil history.
Living crown echinoids bear spines and tube feet, structures that help describe the body plan of familiar sea urchins and sand dollars.
Ordovician bothriocidaroid plates document an early part of the echinoid total-group record, without by themselves dating the crown group’s origin.
evidenceSummary: The Ordovician bothriocidaroid plates and the modelled crown-group date are different kinds of evidence, not competing measurements of the same event. Living species vary in diet and position on the seafloor, and the global occurrence study supplies no general body-size range. These records therefore do not support one ecological profile for all echinoids.
evidenceSummaryZh: 奥陶纪 Bothriocidaroida 骨板与模型估算的冠群年代属于不同证据，不能当作对同一事件的两次测量。现生海胆的食性和海底生活方式也不相同，全球出现记录研究未给出总体体型范围。因此，这些资料不能支持一个适用于全纲的生态画像。

readerLimitations.en: Darriwilian plates document stem-group material, while the crown-group date comes from a separate phylogenomic model. Living species occupy varied depths and feeding modes; these samples support no single ancestral ecology or class-wide body-size envelope.
readerLimitations.zh: 达瑞威尔期骨板记录的是干群材料，冠群年代则来自另一项系统基因组模型。现生种跨越不同水深和取食方式；这些样本不能确定单一祖先生态或全纲体型范围。

traitsZh: 海胆的壳由方解石板组成；这些耐久构件是追溯该类群化石历史的证据之一。
现生海胆冠群具有棘刺和管足；这些结构有助于描述常见海胆和沙钱的身体构型。
奥陶纪 Bothriocidaroida 类群的骨板记录了海胆总群演化记录的早期部分，但仅凭这些骨板无法确定冠群的起源时间。

overview: Crinoidea—the crinoids, including sea lilies and feather stars—is a class of echinoderms. The cited systematic study describes named early crinoid taxa and identifies the middle Tremadocian as the start of the unproblematic fossil record. It treats Middle Cambrian Echmatocrinus as a problematic assignment, so this profile does not use it to move the class’s secure record earlier.
overviewZh:
海百合纲（Crinoidea）包括海百合和海羊齿，是棘皮动物的一纲。所引系统分类研究描述了具名的早期海百合类群，并指出无争议的化石记录始于特马豆克期中期。研究将中寒武世 Echmatocrinus 的归属视为有问题，因此本档案不以它提前可靠记录的起点。

## 生态与解剖的证据范围

这项早期分类研究不能确定全纲统一的食性、栖地偏好、运动方式、体型范围或生态功能群；其化石材料提供海生背景，但不足以推断整个海百合纲的生态。解剖性状仅限于研究涉及的具名早期类群，不作为全纲不变特征，也不据此建立直系祖先关系。

ecology.diet: The cited early-crinoid systematic study does not establish a class-wide diet.
ecology.habitat: The cited fossils are marine, but this sample does not establish a habitat preference for the entire class.
ecology.locomotion: Locomotion is not reconstructed from this early fossil sample.
ecology.bodySize: The study does not provide a class-wide body-size range beyond its named source material.
ecology.guild: The ecological guild of Crinoidea is unresolved in the cited study.
ecology.dietZh: 所引早期海百合系统学研究没有确定整个海百合纲的食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引化石来自海相环境，但这些样本不能确定整个海百合纲的栖息地偏好。
ecology.locomotionZh: 这批早期化石样本不足以重建运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 除研究中明确列出的材料外，该研究未提供涵盖整个海百合纲的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 所引研究尚未明确海百合纲的生态功能类群。

traits: The study describes anatomical characters in named early crinoid taxa; those observations remain tied to the taxa and material it examines.
The class-level record is kept separate from the problematic Middle Cambrian Echmatocrinus assignment.
evidenceSummary: The cited systematic study supports a middle Tremadocian unproblematic record and describes early crinoid anatomy. The time-scale interval for the middle Tremadocian is 486.85–477.1 Ma, but the source does not supply a point-dated global first appearance. Its sample is not a global distribution or ecological reconstruction, and the discussed anatomical characters do not establish direct ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 特马豆克期中期在现行时间表中约为 486.85–477.1 Ma；来源没有给出一个精确到单点的全球首次出现年龄。该研究支持的是无争议记录的阶段尺度起点，并将有争议的 Echmatocrinus 单独处理。
traitsZh: 研究描述了具名早期海百合类群的解剖特征；这些观察仅适用于所研究的类群和材料。
纲级记录与归属存在问题的中寒武世 Echmatocrinus 分开处理。

overview: An extinct echinoderm class represented here by the Sandbian Macurdablastus record and a separately sourced Wuchiapingian last occurrence, rather than by an inferred extinction-boundary instant.

ecology.diet: Undetermined from the cited systematic and functional sources
ecology.habitat: Fossil locality context only; no class-wide habitat inferred
ecology.locomotion: Not reconstructed for the class from these sources
ecology.bodySize: Not generalized beyond named study material

traits: Macurdablastus treated as a named blastoid record
Hydrospire interpretation retained as source-bounded morphology
evidenceSummary: The displayed endpoints are observed fossil-record bounds from different studies; neither is turned into a universal ecology, an ancestor sequence or a Permian–Triassic extinction instant.

title.en: Two fossil records, two different time bounds
title.zh: 两条化石记录，界定两个不同的时间界限

text.en:
The profile brings together a late Sandbian Macurdablastus record and a separately sourced Wuchiapingian last occurrence. They are observations from different studies, not the first and last points of a fully sampled, continuous history. The difference matters: a named fossil record can anchor a local time bound without fixing the class’s global origin or extinction moment.

A second source examines blastoid hydrospires, an internal anatomical feature. That morphology can be discussed without assigning one diet or habitat to the whole class. The selected fossils and structures provide bounded evidence; they do not recover a complete ecology or turn a Permian–Triassic boundary into the exact instant of blastoid extinction.
text.zh:
本档案并列晚桑比期的 Macurdablastus 记录，以及另一项研究提供的吴家坪期末次出现记录。它们来自不同研究中的实际化石记录，并非经过连续、完整取样后得到的最早点和最晚点。这个区别很重要：具名化石可以约束一个地方的时间界限，却不能确定整个纲的全球起源或灭绝时刻。

另一项来源讨论海蕾体内的水螅沟这一解剖结构。描述这种形态，并不需要把单一食性或生境归给整个纲。这里选取的化石和结构只支持有边界的结论；它们不能复原完整生态，也不能把二叠纪—三叠纪界线等同于海蕾纲灭绝的精确时刻。

Asteroid body fossils kept separate from uncertain trace-fossil assignments

text.en: The asteroid body-fossil record in this profile is anchored by Eriaster ibexensis from the very top of the Tremadocian in Utah. Lower Cambrian Asteriacites traces are not counted as asteroid fossils because their attribution is problematic.
text.zh: 本档案中的海星纲身体化石记录以犹他州特雷马道克阶最顶部的 Eriaster ibexensis 为锚点。较早的寒武纪 Asteriacites 遗迹不计作海星化石，因为其归属存在问题。

The study describes the body-fossil anatomy of *Eriaster ibexensis*.

Asteroid body fossils are treated separately from trace fossils whose attribution remains uncertain.

海星纲身体化石与归属不确定的遗迹化石分开处理。

text.zh: Eriaster 来自来源界定的海相沉积环境。一条出现记录不能确定全纲的食性、运动方式、体型范围或生态功能群。

overview: A class-level profile tied to Floian Stenaster material from the Wah Wah Formation; its displayed endpoint is a stage ceiling, not a point-dated global first appearance.

traits: Class-level ophiuran anatomy in the described Stenaster material
Stage-bounded fossil evidence rather than a global origin estimate
evidenceSummary: Systematic material and a separately resolved PBDB occurrence support the Floian class record, but they do not determine global distribution, ecology or uninterrupted lineage duration.

title.en: A class name anchored by one named fossil sample
title.zh: 以一份具名化石样本锚定纲级名称

text.en: Ophiuroidea includes brittle stars and basket stars, but the fossil evidence summarized here is narrower: the systematic study identifies Stenaster material as an ophiuran at class level. A database occurrence independently places the sample in Utah's Wah Wah Formation. This supports the group's presence in that documented setting; it does not describe every branch of the class or identify a direct ancestor.
text.zh: Ophiuroidea 包括蛇尾类和筐蛇尾类，但本页总结的化石证据范围更窄：系统研究将 Stenaster 材料鉴定为蛇尾类纲级化石。数据库出现记录另将样本定位在美国犹他州 Wah Wah 组。这支持该类群曾出现在这一具名地层，却没有描述整个纲的所有支系，也没有指定直接祖先。

title.en: The Floian age is a stage ceiling
title.zh: 弗洛期年代是一个阶级上限

text.en: The Wah Wah sample is assigned to the Floian, whose older boundary supplies the displayed 477.1 Ma ceiling. That boundary is not a point date on Stenaster or a measured first appearance of all brittle stars. The study does not establish class-wide diet, habitat preference, body size or locomotion, so ecology is kept at the level of the named marine formation rather than filled in from living relatives.
text.zh: Wah Wah 样本被定为弗洛期；该阶较早边界给出页面显示的 477.1 Ma 上限。这个边界不是 Stenaster 标本的点定年，也不是全部蛇尾类的实测首次出现。系统研究没有确定整个纲的食性、栖地偏好、体型或运动方式，因此生态描述只保留具名海相地层背景，不从现生近缘类群直接套用。

overview: The late Darriwilian Holothurian Bed in Wales preserves articulated Oesolcucumaria eostre, including a diagnostic calcareous ring. A separate Cambrian database identification is disputed and is not used as a range endpoint.

ecology.locomotion: The fossil material does not directly record movement.
ecology.bodySize: The available account does not generalize body size beyond the named articulated fossil.

traits: Diagnostic calcareous ring in Oesolcucumaria eostre
Articulated body-fossil anatomy from the Holothurian Bed
evidenceSummary: The calcareous ring and articulated anatomy support a bounded class assignment and a late Darriwilian record. The disputed Cambrian identification does not establish a global origin, and the fossil does not resolve class-wide ecology.

title.en: What one articulated fossil can tell us
title.zh: 一件关节相连的化石能说明什么

text.en: Oesolcucumaria eostre preserves a calcareous ring and articulated body parts in the late Darriwilian Holothurian Bed of Wales. The specimen supports a bounded fossil record for sea cucumbers. A Cambrian database identification is disputed and excluded as an endpoint; this fossil evidence does not establish the class's origin, diet or way of life.
text.zh: Oesolcucumaria eostre 在威尔士 Darriwilian 晚期的 Holothurian Bed 保存了钙质环及关节相连的身体部分。这件标本支持一条范围有限的海参类化石记录。寒武纪数据库鉴定存在争议，因此不作为范围端点；这件化石不能确定整个海参纲的起源、食性或生活方式。
